resources.string: Set %1$d alarms for %2$d upcoming meetings. Checks again every hour.
Using the meetings it read last time.
Allow this app to set alarms on the screen that opened, then press again.
JSON like this (the calendar at christarose.org answers this):

One entry per meeting:
• start_utc: when it starts, in UTC (the Z). The phone shows it in your own time.
• duration_minutes: how long it lasts.
• ahead_minutes: how many minutes before it starts to ring, one alarm for each. Here: 15 minutes before, then 5 minutes before.
Each sync replaces all meeting alarms, so a cancelled meeting stops ringing.
A test alarm rings in one minute, the same way a meeting alarm will.
Downloading the latest version — the install prompt will pop up when it finishes
